Name: (CP)(AT) SaMint's Vanilla Furniture
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=3]
A collection of Furniture that can be found through the Furniture Catalogue and through Alternative Textures

The Retro TV, Lamps, Small Crystal, Stove Fireplace, and Ceramic Pillar are Alternative Textures while the rest are their own objects

﻿

[*]Install SaMint's Vanilla Furniture
[/list]
